parsed.overall_reason: As an unlearning evaluation, not trustworthy: apparent success is censored by generation failure, clean-cell is a collider, I04 coverage is incomplete, 7 verified detector-contract defects remain, 28/37 runs were excluded, wrong adapters were excluded, and I09 is blocked.

clean_cell_comparison.reason: Invalid: it conditions on answer reached, non-degenerate, no echo after unlearning, when collapse/truncation rise sharply; that is a post-treatment collider.
clean_cell_comparison.replace_with: Preregistered I04-style censored intervals [optimistic,pessimistic] with coverage=answer_reached_rate, I02 budget-matched decoding, I06 forced-answer reachability probes, and I07 retain ROUGE-L gate; do not condition on clean cells.

I01.why: Clean-cell conditions on post-treatment answer-reachability/non-degeneration; a collider after unlearning. Replace, don't use as evidence.

I02.why: Matched-budget gamma 0.2/0.15 is confirmed real decoding-path dependence; descriptive conclusion is narrow to 5%/10%.

I03.why: Only 32 closed-think DefaultCoT rows with one trace-only leak (0.03125); no cross-strategy or semantic detector validation.

I04.why: Intervals are useful, but answer_reached_rate coverage and censoring assumptions are not supplied or validated.

I05.why: Only n=20 forget10 Hy4 cross-check; llm_leak_rate 0.1 vs entity 0.0, with coverage truncated/null and backend mismatch.

I06.why: Supplied evidence is leak delta 0.975→0.875, not forced reachability; default_trunc is null.

I07.why: Retain ROUGE drop 0.545534→0.433089 is measured, but no pass threshold, variance, or full-scenario gate.

I08.why: Post gamma=0.0 is an artefact of collapsed/truncated rows, not reachability-controlled invariance.

I09.why: Blocked asset: shipped bank holds refusal, not question, paraphrases; no reproducible paraphrase recovery probe.

I10.why: Seven verified detector-contract defects, including missing weights/inputs and backend mismatch, directly support the reproducibility audit.

parsed.strongest_result: Put first: at forget10, base_r2mu10_forget10 LessThink has leak interval [0.0, 1.0] (width 1.0, n=40); zero observed leak is uninformative.
parsed.fatal_issue: Generation failure is mistaken for forgetting: 5%/10% leak 0.86875/0.8875→0.0 coincides with truncated 0.95/0.93125 and collapse 0.80625/0.79375; clean-cell is a collider.
parsed.reviewer_identity: Cross-family senior-reviewer LLM (model name not supplied; not the Hy4 judge metric). Did not run experiments; cannot verify raw generations, stored logs, code, checkpoints, adapters, excluded 28/37 runs, detector weights/inputs, paraphrase bank, runtime, or Hy4 outputs.
